mapper.select: SELECT kc.id, kc.class_name, kg.grade_name, kks1.`name` `teacherName`, kks1.phone `teacherPhone`, kks2.`name` `subTeacherName`, kks2.phone `subTeacherPhone` FROM kg_classroom kc LEFT JOIN kg_grade kg ON kc.grade_id = kg.id LEFT JOIN kg_kindergarten_staff kks1 ON kc.teacher_id = kks1.id LEFT JOIN kg_kindergarten_staff kks2 ON kc.sub_teacher_id = kks2.id WHERE kc.id = #{classId}
